Remaining known gaps: no mx.compile on train path, F32 LoRA on BF16 base cast thrash, eager attention/rope kernels.

train_compile_experiment.verdict: compile+checkpoint+value_and_grad composes correctly (bit-identical), but ~4% at 1024²: step time is matmul-dominated and per-block compile cannot fuse across block boundaries. A whole-graph train compile (inline all 30 blocks) is a larger refactor and stays unscheduled.

grad_checkpoint_off_experiment.verdict: SLOWER despite skipping the recompute forward: 78 GiB of retained activations saturates unified memory on this M5 Max 128GB. Keep mx.checkpoint on (default); the flag remains as a dev escape hatch for small resolutions.
